verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Seeing, therefore, that we are the portion of the Holy One, let us do all those things which pertain to holiness, avoiding all evil-speaking, all abominable and impure embraces, together with all drunkenness, seeking after change, all abominable lusts, detestable adultery, and execrable pride.
verses.modernizedText: Since, therefore, we are the portion of the Holy One, let us do all those things that pertain to holiness, avoiding all evil-speaking, all abominable and impure embraces, together with all drunkenness, a desire for change, all abominable lusts, detestable adultery, and execrable pride.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: “For God,” [saith the Scripture], “resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.”
verses.modernizedText: “For God,” [says the Scripture], “resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let us cleave, then, to those to whom grace has been given by God.
verses.modernizedText: Let us cleave, then, to those to whom grace has been given by God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let us clothe ourselves with concord and humility, ever exercising self-control, standing far off from all whispering and evil-speaking, being justified by our works, and not our words.
verses.modernizedText: Let us clothe ourselves with concord and humility, always exercising self-control, standing far from all whispering and evil-speaking, being justified by our works and not our words.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For [the Scripture] saith, “He that speaketh much, shall also hear much in answer.
verses.modernizedText: For [the Scripture] says, “He who speaks much will also hear much in answer.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And does he that is ready in speech deem himself righteous?
verses.modernizedText: And does he who is ready in speech consider himself righteous?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Blessed is he that is born of woman, who liveth but a short time: be not given to much speaking.”
verses.modernizedText: Blessed is he who is born of woman and lives but a short time: do not give yourself to much speaking.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let our praise be in God, and not of ourselves; for God hateth those that commend themselves.
verses.modernizedText: Let our praise be in God and not in ourselves, for God hates those who commend themselves.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let testimony to our good deeds be borne by others, as it was in the case of our righteous forefathers.
verses.modernizedText: Let others bear testimony to our good deeds, as was the case with our righteous forefathers.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Boldness, and arrogance, and audacity belong to those that are accursed of God; but moderation, humility, and meekness to such as are blessed by Him.
verses.modernizedText: Boldness, arrogance, and audacity belong to those who are accursed by God, but moderation, humility, and meekness belong to those who are blessed by Him.
